description: This file defines the Result class for handling mysqli query results within Drupal's database abstraction layer, including methods for counting rows, setting fetch modes, and fetching data.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Handles mysqli query results, providing row counting, fetch mode setting, and data fetching functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Result object with fetch mode, options, mysqli result, and connection.

methods.name: rowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected or matched by the query, parsing the mysqli connection info string.

methods.name: setFetchMode
methods.description: Sets the fetch mode; in mysqli, this is a no-op and always returns true.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches a row from the result set, converting all non-NULL values to strings and applying the fetch mode.
